items.title: Brock Bowers (ankle) was limited on Wednesday.
items.text: Bowers closed last week with two limited sessions, listed with ankle and quad injuries. Fortunately, the quad injury is no longer an issue. He is tentatively on track to play in Week 12 against the Browns. Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said he is optimistic that Bowers will play this weekend, adding that having a bye in Week 13 will not factor into whether Bowers suits up this week. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Jahan Dotson (hamstring) did not practice on Wednesday.
items.text: Dotson and Zachariah Branch (hamstring) both missed Wednesday’s practice. Dotson is not relevant in 12-team leagues, and Branch has earned just 12 targets this season. Neither player is consequential. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports that coach Mike McCarthy “has the full support” of the Steelers’ organization and the team is “not planning to make any immediate changes.”
items.text: McCarthy can rest easy knowing that the organization fully backs him. Rapoport’s “immediate changes” phrasing does allow room for interpretation, though. Perhaps the team could move on in the offseason. Until then, McCarthy will roll with Mason Rudolph as his starting quarterback. They face the Broncos on Friday. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Carson Beck (back) did not practice on Wednesday.
items.text: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said Beck has been steadily improving since back spasms hit him late in Thursday’s practice. The team is taking it one day at a time with him. The team is preparing to start Josh Johnson in Week 12 against the Commanders this week. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Cardinals claimed QB Kedon Slovis off waivers.
items.text: The former Raven is now a Cardinal. He was notably on Arizona’s roster last summer. Slovis could end up taking live reps, pending Carson Beck’s (back) health and Josh Johnson’s performance, but he would only be a QB2/3 in that instance. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Chargers claimed CB Avery Smith off waivers.
items.text: The Chargers traded Smith to the Seahawks earlier this year. The Seahawks waived him on Tuesday. Whether Smith plays meaningful snaps remains to be seen, but he is familiar with the system. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Juwan Johnson (hamstring) was not seen practicing on Wednesday.
items.text: Johnson is unlikely to play in Week 12 against the Bengals at this point. The Saints’ No. 1 tight end injured his hamstring last week. Recovering in one week is a tall task for a player who needs to be able to stride while running routes. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Taliese Fuaga (knee) was seen practicing on Wednesday.
items.text: Fuaga, the Saints’ right tackle, and C Erik McCoy (biceps) were both practicing on Wednesday. This is great news for the offense overall. Getting both players back would be helpful this week against the Bengals’ talented defensive line. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) was limited on Wednesday.
items.text: Meyers has been dealing with this ankle issue for weeks now, but it has not impacted his game-day availability. Meyers is FLEX-viable against a soft Titans pass defense in Week 12. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Carnell Tate (shoulder) is practicing in full for Week 12 against the Jaguars.
items.text: Tate returned from his multi-week absence last week, posting a 2/58/1 receiving line. He faces the Jaguars’ capable defense in Week 12, but his role and talent keep him in the WR3 tier. Tate looks like a classic rookie wide receiver set to produce late in the season. - Nic Bodiford
